factory_context.plant: 東浜精機 第2工場（架空）

central_question: 販売計画と確定受注、品目別製造実績・在庫・限界利益・共通部品制約を踏まえ、翌月の生産と供給をどう優先すべきか
supported_answer: 工場全体の生産達成率は高いが需要と品目構成が合っていない。CXの製造を抑え、AX/DXの供給優先度を高め、共通IC-7の追加確保を条件付きで判断する。同時にBX×東亜の赤字取引条件を見直す。

cross_ledger_checks.name: BOM explosions against net forecast units
Capacity, quality holds and shipment cutoff cannot be proven
cross_ledger_checks.limitation: No order-level allocation / quality-hold / fulfillment cutoff event data.

operational_scenarios.name: Constrained supply
operational_scenarios.tradeoff: Protects procurement cost but sacrifices customer deliveries and modeled contribution.

operational_scenarios.name: Conditionally expedited supply
operational_scenarios.tradeoff: Greater modeled contribution but supplier, quality, capacity and demand risks remain.

decisions.decision: Negotiate and conditionally authorize 540 IC-7 expedite
decisions.condition: Confirm lead time, approved material, all-in fee <=0.81 mJPY, capacity, and firm-order basis
decisions.reversal_trigger: No delivery/quality confirmation or demand falls below break-even

decisions.decision: Adjust AX/DX production allocation; postpone CX November builds if FG is available
decisions.owner: 生産管理・製造・営業
decisions.condition: Confirm finished stock is sellable and free for the November committed shipment dates
decisions.reversal_trigger: CX firm orders exceed accessible FG or A/D capacity/material unavailable

decisions.condition: Validate customer contract and price elasticity
decisions.reversal_trigger: Loss of volume or strategic service harm outweighs margin gain

business_limitations: Variable contribution is not operating profit
No firm November order coverage provided
No independent material alternatives, line capacity and quality data
Customer shipment cutoff and available stock cannot be disambiguated
